newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar retreats into losses by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar retreats into losses by close.

text.p: White sugar futures turned round earlier gains on Tuesday as players took profits after the rally inspired by the raws market ran its course, traders said.
Volume was brisk after funds pushed the market higher on the New York opening but the sellers soon took command to take gains of nearly $3.00 at one stage into negative territory.
The nearby March/March premium against New York also retreated.
At the close, December was down $2.20 at $320.00 and March went off at $316.50, a $1.80 loss on the day.
Volumes were high with the December contract trading 1,475 lots, just three behind the March, the two front contracts dominating business.
A similar pattern could be seen in Paris where volume reached 1,243 lots. December was down 20 cents at $322.00 and March up $1.30 at $320.00.
